name: Lizard's tail
desc: Lizard's tail (Saururus cernuus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 55 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Saururus cernuus (lizard's tail, water-dragon, dragon's tail, swamp root) is a species of herbaceous perennial plant. The plant grows up to about 1 metre (3+1⁄2 ft) tall.
